catalogRow: N11 section: Codex shapes spliced into tool schemas at runtime (schema_binding.rs:3)

payload.name: session_inspect
payload.description: Inspects one exact conversation target without changing its identity. Attachment or backend failures retain structured target/effect evidence.

EndpointRef.description:
An adapter endpoint within one Router service, independent of its locator.

`service_id` identifies the Router service; `endpoint_id` selects the
stable named adapter endpoint within that service.

outputSchema.title: McpToolOutput
outputSchema.description: A successful tool result or a typed structured MCP tool error.

EndpointRef.description:
An adapter endpoint within one Router service, independent of its locator.

`service_id` identifies the Router service; `endpoint_id` selects the
stable named adapter endpoint within that service.

CodexGeneration.description: One managed backend incarnation within a particular service process lifetime.

oneOf.description:
The broker holds no access route for this thread, so the app-server
default governs its access. Threads created before routes were recorded
still resume; their access is inherited rather than Router-selected.
